positions.locationName: Havelock, North Carolina, United States · On-site

positions.title: Warehouse Supply Specialist
positions.locationName: Newport, North Carolina, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Manage accountability for 110,000+ line items representing more than 3.5 million components supporting the AV-8B Harrier Program using SAP EWM, AMPS, and ISO-based systems.
Support AV-8B program closure and inventory reduction through reutilization, reallocation, redistribution, transfer, and disposition of material.
Led warehouse optimization efforts that reduced required floor space by 50% while maintaining readiness, accountability, and customer support.
Analyze inventory metrics, reconcile discrepancies, identify operational risks, and support corrective actions, regulatory requirements, and audit readiness.
Standardized accountability workflows to improve inventory visibility, reduce redundant actions, and strengthen operational efficiency.
positions.insights: Skills: Process Improvement · Supply Operations · Performance Analysis · Distribution · Program Monitoring · Inventory Management · Logistics Management · Supply Chain Management · Warehouse Operations · Inventory Control · Materials Management · SAP Extended Warehouse Management (SAP EWM) · Data Analysis

positions.title: Web Developer & Digital Content Specialist
positions.description:
Developed, updated, and maintained websites for authors and independent clients, managing content changes, site functionality, and digital presentation.
Translated client needs into practical website solutions while independently managing multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines.
Provided ongoing website maintenance, troubleshooting, content updates, and client support throughout long-term engagements.
Managed freelance projects from initial client request through implementation, revision, and continued support.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Responsive Web Design · Webmaster Services · Content Management · Client Relations · Project Management

positions.title: Senior OEM Communications Specialist
positions.description:
Promoted to expand customer-focused communications across Warranty Communications while retaining ownership of ServiceLine and OEM dealer training.
Led enterprise North American and global warranty communications and dealer-distribution operations across Warranty, Service, Parts, IT, and OEM organizations.
Led a 20-person Six Sigma/Voice of Customer initiative, consolidating 197 stakeholder inputs into 76 unique requirements and redesigning communication workflows around customer needs.
Implemented Eloqua for TRP, Campaign, and Friday Fax communications and developed QSOL self-service subscriptions that allowed dealers to select relevant markets and communications while reducing manual distribution-list maintenance.
Created transition plans and trained Warranty Communications specialists on Eloqua, QSOL subscriptions, and redesigned workflows. Developed and delivered customer-service training for Cummins employees and contractors.
Created and presented communications for OEM customer executives and Cummins leadership, using Voice of Customer feedback to support cross-functional action planning and service improvement.

positions.title: OEM Communications Specialist
positions.description:
Created and owned ServiceLine, a centralized warranty and service communications resource for North American OEM dealers, with tailored content for Freightliner, PACCAR, Kenworth, and other OEM networks.
Led recurring Parts, Service, and Warranty content meetings; authored warranty communications, edited subject-matter-expert content, coordinated reviews, and managed publication and distribution.
Developed and facilitated an OEM dealer training program, coordinating trainers and delivering live and recorded sessions for approximately 50 participants at a time.
Partnered with Cummins and OEM IT teams to integrate training and service resources into dealer-facing websites and systems.
Managed OEM dealer distribution lists and subscription processes, improving recipient accuracy and access to relevant communications.

positions.title: Warranty Operations Support Specialist / RAPIDSERVE
positions.description:
Adjudicated online and global warranty claims with authority to approve, deny, request additional documentation, and adjust noncompliant claim elements in accordance with warranty policies, technical procedures, and maintenance requirements.
Worked directly with technicians and claim filers on online warranty claims, providing troubleshooting assistance, clarifying submission requirements, and guiding customers through the claim process.
Reviewed high-dollar global claims in WWIMS for technical and policy compliance, including multi-million-dollar claims; validated labor, standard repair times, parts, and supporting documentation before authorizing payment.
Served as an experienced Cummins resource within an organization of approximately 10 Cummins employees working alongside 80 contractors, providing troubleshooting and claims guidance before issues required management escalation.
Facilitated Telephone Etiquette and Through the Lens of the Customer training for approximately 150 new employees per course.
Conducted customer-satisfaction surveys, maintained results in Excel, developed OEM-specific PowerPoint reporting, and presented customer trends to identify service issues and improvement opportunities.
Mentored employees and coordinated with Engineering, Manufacturing, Service, Warranty, and other business functions to resolve complex customer and warranty issues while meeting established monthly performance requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Employee Training · Contact Centers · Warranty Administration · Customer Satisfaction · Instructor-led Training · Communication · Troubleshooting · Data Analysis · Claims Management · Technical Support · Customer Service · Microsoft Excel

positions.title: Pneumatics/Hydraulics Aircraft Mechanic
positions.locationName: Cherry Point Marine Corps Base, North Carolina · On-site
positions.description:
Selected through a competitive Apprentice College-to-Career Program and progressed through a multi-year Worker-to-Journey developmental track, completing a formal Department of the Navy apprenticeship and qualifying as a journeyman pneudraulic Systems Mechanic.
Completed rotations through eight specialized pneudraulic maintenance shops, gaining hands-on experience with valves and regulators, starters and turbines, compressors, auxiliary power units, fuel controls and accessories, hydraulic motors and pumps, propeller controls, accumulators, actuators, servos, and winches.
Troubleshot, disassembled, inspected, repaired, assembled, tested, and evaluated complex pneumatic and hydraulic aircraft systems and components in accordance with technical requirements and established maintenance procedures.
Applied Continuous Process Improvement principles using Lean, Six Sigma, 5S+1, and Theory of Constraints methodologies to streamline workflows, reduce bottlenecks, and improve operational performance.
Collaborated with Quality Assurance, Production Control, Industrial Engineering, Supply, and maintenance personnel to resolve process issues and support timely completion of maintenance actions.
Contributed to shop performance that achieved zero workable overdue components while maintaining compliance with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, OHSAS 18001, AS9100, safety, environmental, and quality requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: Lean Operations · System Testing · Manufacturing Operations · Pneumatic System Maintenance · Hydraulic Systems · Soldering · Aircraft Maintenance · Troubleshooting · Lean Six Sigma · Quality Assurance · 5S
